## Council question

Are Spice Blows drawn from one prepared deck or two?

## Why this needs a ruling

Quickstart v0.8 describes the Spice Deck in the singular. The live Fremen sheet says Fremen may look at the top card of both Spice Blow Decks.

## Answer needed

Specify the number of draw piles and discard piles, how draws alternate, and which top cards Fremen may inspect.

## Provisional drafting approach

Resolve the pile structure before writing prescience or worm examples.

This is a research question, not an adopted ruling or a claim that Norbert has answered it. No answer has been supplied yet. Keep the affected rules provisional until Norbert or the council confirms them.

## Sources

[Live Fremen](https://dune.zone/factions/fremen); Quickstart v0.8, Spice Deck and Spice Blow Knowledge.

Part of #1831. Record the confirmed answer, its date and a worked example here before closing. Norbert will share this link with the council; this ticket does not send them a message.
title: Dreamrules ruling: Are Spice Blows drawn from one prepared deck or two?
